# One row per recipe in the build plan: recipe | library | licence | how it reaches the programs | licence text
# (the last column is only for a source that keeps its licence in a header or its README)
# "linked" means the library's code is inside ffmpeg, ffprobe or portico-disc. "headers" means only
# its interface is compiled in and the code runs from the driver on the person's machine.
# "build only" means it is used while building and is not in the programs.
# The licence column is checked against the licence file collected from each pinned source (the
# sources stage copies those files into the bundle's LICENSES folder). A row whose licence says
# non-free stops the build. FFmpeg itself, built this way, is GPL-3.0-or-later.
20-libiconv | GNU libiconv | LGPL-2.1-or-later | linked
20-zlib | zlib | Zlib | linked

25-gmp | GMP | LGPL-3.0-or-later OR GPL-2.0-or-later | linked
25-libogg | libogg | BSD-3-Clause | linked
25-libxml2 | libxml2 | MIT | linked
25-openssl | OpenSSL | Apache-2.0 | linked
